title: TAI owner exact deployment command
objective: Provide an observable owner-only exact-main deployment command that revalidates the successful restricted Qwen activation and all eight activation jobs, invokes only the protected REG.RU controller, and keeps the production self-hosted deployment job actionless while validating and checksumming root-owned evidence locally.
boundaries: The only production command is /tai deploy current-main on issue 3365 or the owner-only current-main workflow dispatch
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner where applicable
The latest exact commit status TAI Restricted Qwen REG.RU Activation must be success
The status target must identify an exact workflow run in this repository
The referenced activation run is revalidated for exact SHA, workflow name, branch, repository, run attempt and allowed actor pair
All eight activation jobs remain mandatory and fail-closed
The existing rootless image and protected pc-tai-release-controller remain the only deployment authority
The production self-hosted deployment job contains shell steps only and downloads no third-party GitHub Action
Predeploy, deployment and postdeploy evidence remain root-owned on REG.RU, are exact-target validated, and are SHA-256 checksummed without printing contents
Successful deployment requires a complete evidence set and a blocker-free passing postflight
Every command publishes redacted terminal evidence
No model, tenant, role, financial or write authority is widened
